scope: 仅移除近似既有派系徽记；不改核心造型

arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY a small painted insignia on the central white chest plate of the supplied orange-white humanoid mecha. Remove the orange angular animal-face/faction insignia entirely and replace that patch with the same plain clean ivory-white armor paint, preserving the chest panel seams and lighting. No replacement logo or mark. Keep absolutely everything else unchanged: exact head and crown, long orange-white mane, cyan eyes, all hands and thick fist units, orange forearms, shoulder armor, waist, full legs/feet, proportions, pose, shadow, ivory background, framing and illustration style. Do not alter anatomy or redesign the mecha; a single tiny chest insignia removal only. Preserve source full portrait aspect ratio.
